definitions.gloss: prison break; jailbreak; escape from prison
definitions.explanation: The act of escaping from a prison or jail. Used in news reports, crime fiction, and historical accounts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{囚人|しゅうじん}→囚人：20680_shuujin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{脱獄|だつごく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{脱獄|だつごく}{犯|はん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{捕|つか}まっていない→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The escaped prisoner has not been caught yet.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧にあった{脱獄|だつごく}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{基|もと}にして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The movie is based on a real prison break incident.

notes:
{脱獄|だつごく} means escaping from prison. Composed of {脱|だつ} (escape) + {獄|ごく} (prison).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {脱獄|だつごく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break out of prison
- {脱獄|だつごく}{犯|はん}: escaped prisoner
- {脱獄|だつごく}⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧: prison break incident
- {脱獄|だつごく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{企|くわだ}てる→企てる：15422_kuwadateru⟧: to plan a prison break
- {脱獄|だつごく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧: to attempt a prison escape
- {脱獄|だつごく}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧: attempted jailbreak

MODERN USAGE:
Also used informally in computing to mean "jailbreaking" a device (removing software restrictions on a phone or tablet).

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{脱走|だっそう}→脱走：15529_dassou⟧: escape, desertion (broader — from military, institution, etc.)
- ⟦{逃亡|とうぼう}→逃亡：14367_toubou⟧: flight, running away (after escaping)
- ⟦{投獄|とうごく}→投獄：15733_tougoku⟧: imprisonment (opposite — putting someone in prison)
